reforms.description: The introduction of emissions trading under the Clean Air Act represents an innovative approach to pollution control, allowing for the trading of emission permits to meet specific targets.
reforms.package_name: Clean Air Act Emissions Trading Program
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Emissions trading encourages cost-effective pollution reduction, fostering innovation in pollution control technologies and practices.
reforms.status_evidence: The SO trading system has been in operation since 1992.
reforms.importance_rationale: The emissions trading program represents a significant shift in environmental policy, moving from command-and-control regulations to market-based mechanisms, which has had a substantial impact on reducing emissions.
reforms.source_quote: A particularly innovative approach to pollution control – emissions trading– has been introduced in two programmes under the Clean Air Act.
